description: An inline svg as a replaced box: sizes, viewBox and preserveAspectRatio, CSS giving fills and colour, a gradient, text, overflow, and a size from the width and the ratio

florui.css: .wrap { position: relative; width: 540px; height: 200px; background-color: #ffffff; } .s { position: absolute; border: 2px solid #2a3a58; background-color: #f4f4f4; } .k { fill: #d05040; stroke: #2a3a58; stroke-width: 3; } .p2 { color: #4070d0; } .p6 { width: 100px; }.p0 { left: 20px; top: 20px; } .p1 { left: 150px; top: 20px; } .p2 { left: 280px; top: 20px; } .p3 { left: 410px; top: 20px; } .p4 { left: 20px; top: 110px; } .p5 { left: 150px; top: 110px; } .p6 { left: 280px; top: 110px; } .p7 { left: 410px; top: 110px; }

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 0.19% of the pixels differ by more than 24 levels of a channel and every box has the same bounding box. What is left is the edge of the glyphs and of the gradient, which Chromium dithers. It covers an inline svg sized by its attributes, by a viewBox with preserveAspectRatio (meet and slice), by CSS, and by a width and the ratio of its viewBox; shapes given their fill and colour by rules; a gradient; text in the page font; and overflow. With the svgs left out of the flow, as when they had no box, the same fixture measures 42.80%, so it fails.
